home.headline: Speak idioms clearly. Learn words that stick.
home.subtitle: Search vocabulary, practice pronunciation with live match scores, and level up through Easy, Medium, and Hard games.
home.aboutBody: Idiomify is an NLP-powered English learning app for project demonstrations. It helps learners move from knowing a word to speaking it correctly — with instant feedback, idiom categories, and gamified drills.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation checker
pronunciation.description: Speak into the mic and get a speech match score with helpful feedback.

games.description: Easy MCQ, Medium cloze, and Hard timed speaking drills with points.

badges.title: Badges & progress
badges.description: Earn points, unlock badges, and track your learning milestones.

steps.1: Search a word or idiom to see its definition and example.
steps.2: Practice speaking and receive a live match accuracy score.
steps.3: Play Easy, Medium, or Hard games to reinforce learning.
steps.4: Collect points and unlock badges in your dashboard.

practice.title: Practice speaking
practice.subtitle: Speak the target phrase to get a speech match score. Score 80%+ to earn +15 points. Use Demo Mode if the microphone is unavailable.
practice.pickHint: Pick a word or idiom to practice aloud.

speak.unsupported: Web Speech API unavailable here. Use Chrome on desktop, or Demo Mode.
speak.notSupported: Speech recognition is not supported in this browser. Use Demo Mode.
speak.micDenied: Microphone permission denied. Enable mic access or use Demo Mode.
speak.pythonUnsupported: Python scoring is not available on this device. Try Demo Mode or Chrome desktop.
speak.pythonFailed: Could not score with Python. Falling back to browser speech if available.
speak.pythonOffline: Python scoring server is offline. Start it on port 8000, or use Demo Mode.
speak.pythonServerError: Python scoring server returned an error. Try again or use Demo Mode.
speak.errorHint: Tip: keep the Python server running, allow microphone access, or use Demo Mode.
speak.scoringNote: Score compares speech-to-text against the target (ASR similarity), not phoneme diagnostics.
speak.diffNote: Word comparison (target vs what was heard)

feedback.close: Close! Listen to the reference and try again.
feedback.keepPracticing: Keep practicing — slow down and enunciate.
feedback.tryAgain: Try again — speak the target phrase clearly.

games.subtitle: Train meaning, listening, and speaking — then climb the daily board.

easy.title: Easy
easy.hubBlurb: Warm up with quizzes, matching, flashcards, and timed speed rounds.
easy.pageSubtitle: Pick a mode. +10 points per correct answer / known card.
easy.question: Question {number}
easy.matchingHint: Select a term, then its definition.
easy.speedHint: 8 seconds each · 3 lives · streaks boost the pressure.

medium.title: Medium
medium.hubBlurb: Cloze, listening, scramble, and dictation for deeper recall.
medium.pageSubtitle: Pick a mode. +20 points per correct answer.
medium.listeningHint: Play the audio first. Options unlock after you listen.
medium.listenFirst: Listen to the audio before answering.
medium.scrambleBuild: Tap words to rebuild the idiom
medium.dictationPrompt: Listen, then type what you heard.
medium.dictationHint: Replay as needed, then type the exact idiom.

hard.title: Hard
hard.hubBlurb: Timed speaking drills and multi-phrase pressure rounds.
hard.pageSubtitle: Speak clearly before the timer ends. Pass at 80%+ for +30 points. Time gets tighter as you go.
hard.timeUp: Time’s up — try the next drill.
hard.multiHint: Clear each phrase before time runs out. Later phrases get less time.

daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.hubBlurb: A fixed five-step mix that refreshes every day — compete on the leaderboard.
daily.pageSubtitle: MCQ → cloze → scramble → dictation → speak. Same set for everyone today.
daily.leaderboardHint: Signed-in scores sync when Supabase daily_scores is set up. Local best always saves on this device.
daily.leaderboardEmpty: No shared scores yet — finish a run to post yours.
